caption:
349,499 people rated this bathroom scale. Almost none call it flimsy.

A scale is one of the few gadgets you use in silence, first thing in the morning, with no patience for guessing. At $16.87 it sits well under what most bathroom scales cost, which is usually the first thing people ask about before checking anything else.

The Etekcity Digital Body Weight Bathroom Scale gives a plain numeric readout with no setup beyond stepping on. A 4.7-star average across 349,499 reviews is the kind of sample size that stops being anecdote and starts being data.

For $16.87 you get a scale with review volume most home gadgets never come close to. That number is the actual selling point here, not a claim about how it feels to use.
